proposals.evidence: CDIAL 4655.3 caturaḥ explicitly gives Bshk. čōr, Kalasha čāu, Khowar čhor, Maiya čōur and Palula čūr. These northern o/u forms require subsection 3, correcting the candidate’s subsection-2 link; western cār remains in subsection 2. Reviewed comparison: Buksa tʃaɾ “four” (f_iqldegzn6g5h6). The family link leaves local phonetic details and possible transfer between Indo-Aryan languages open; no source spelling is changed.

The survey affricate-to-sibilant and contracted nasal/glide numerals fit this documented five family; exact local phonetic developments remain qualified.
